name: hibira
description: Hibira realtime for Codex: the Hibira MCP server plus skills for wiring channels, push notifications, AI streaming, human approvals and waiting rooms into your app.

interface.shortDescription: Realtime WebSockets and push for apps
interface.longDescription: Skills for adding Hibira realtime to your app: Pusher-compatible channels for web, mobile and backends, moving from Pusher, push notifications for iOS, Android and browsers, resumable AI chat streaming and human approvals for agents. The connected Hibira MCP server works on the account you sign in with: list and create apps, get the setup guide for your SDK with your app's values filled in, send a test event and watch the debug console. It asks before creating apps or sending push notifications to real devices.
defaultPrompt: Add live order updates to this app with Hibira.
Move this project from Pusher to Hibira.
Stream my AI chat answers over Hibira so they survive reloads.
